def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); types = list(feats.types)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def fit(cols):
        Z = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] if not isinstance(j, tuple) else X[:, j[0]] * X[:, j[1]] for j in cols]) if cols else S
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1]); ll0 = -np.inf
        for _ in range(50):
            eta = Z @ b; pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); ll = np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta))
            if ll - ll0 < 1e-8 and ll >= ll0: break
            W = pr * (1 - pr) + 1e-9; H = Z.T @ (Z * W[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - pr)); t = 1.0
            while t > 1e-4:
                e2 = Z @ (b + t * step)
                if np.sum(y * e2 - np.logaddexp(0, e2)) >= ll - 1e-10: break
                t /= 2
            b = b + t * step; ll0 = ll
        eta = Z @ b
        return np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)), 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
    deg = (np.abs(R) >= 0.6).sum(0) - 1
    hubs = [j for j in range(p) if types[j] == 'clinical' and deg[j] >= 3]
    hubs = sorted(hubs, key=lambda j: -deg[j])[:3]
    def gain(j, sel):
        nui = [h for h in hubs if h != j and h not in sel and abs(R[h, j]) < 0.99 and all(abs(R[h, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        return 2 * (fit(sel + nui + [j])[0] - fit(sel + nui)[0])
    sel = []; gates = [0.05, 0.05, 0.02]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        g = {j: gain(j, sel) for j in cand}; best = max(g, key=g.get)
        if stats.chi2.sf(g[best], 1) > gates[min(len(sel), 2)] / p: break
        clus = [k for k in range(p) if k not in sel and abs(R[best, k]) >= 0.6] + [best]
        base = fit(sel)[0]; L = {k: fit(sel + [k])[0] for k in clus}; top = max(L.values())
        hb = [k for k in clus if k in hubs and L[k] >= top - 5]
        if hb: best = hb[0]
        else:
            ok = [k for k in clus if L[k] >= top - 2]
            best = min(ok, key=lambda k: sum(max(0, 2 * (fit(sel + [k, m])[0] - L[k])) for m in clus if m != k))
        sel.append(best)
    while len(sel) > 1:
        full = fit(sel)[0]; pv = [stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - fit([s for s in sel if s != j])[0]), 1) for j in sel]
        w = int(np.argmax(pv))
        if pv[w] < 0.05 / p: break
        sel.pop(w)
    if len(sel) == 1 and stats.chi2.sf(2 * (fit(sel)[0] - fit([])[0]), 1) > 0.05 / p: sel = []
    ll, pr = fit(sel)
    Zs = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel]); W = pr * (1 - pr)
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    Pm = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    H = Zs.T @ (Zs * W[:, None]); C = Zs.T @ (Pm * W[:, None])
    v = (Pm * Pm * W[:, None]).sum(0) - np.sum(C * np.linalg.solve(H, C), 0)
    sc = (Pm.T @ (y - pr)) ** 2 / np.maximum(v, 1e-9)
    prods = []; alpha = 0.005 / len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        if len(prods) >= 2 or any({a, b} & set(q) for q in prods): continue
        base = sel + [k for k in (a, b) if k not in sel]
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (fit(base + [(a, b)])[0] - fit(base)[0]), 1) < alpha: prods.append((a, b))
    if prods:
        mains = [k for q in prods for k in q]; cols = sel + [k for k in mains if k not in sel] + prods
        full = fit(cols)[0]
        sel = [s for s in sel if s in mains or stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - fit([c for c in cols if c != s])[0]), 1) < 0.02 / p]
    drivers = []
    for k in sel + [k for q in prods for k in q]:
        if k not in drivers and all(abs(R[k, d]) < 0.85 for d in drivers): drivers.append(k)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [k for q in prods for k in q]))
    if drivers: cols += [h for h in hubs if h not in cols]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[k] for k in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[k] for k in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
